study type: Descriptive study / Surgical technique demonstration (case series)
exposure: Hysteroscopy-assisted transvaginal repair technique without scar defect resection
outcome: Efficacy and viability of the repair technique
Potential shortening of contraception time after operation
cohort: 15 women diagnosed as having a niche in the uterus.
finding: The novel hysteroscopy-assisted transvaginal repair technique without scar defect resection is an efficacious and viable approach to treat uterine niche, and it may help shorten contraception time after the operation by retaining the integrity of the uterine myometrium.
